verdict.rationale: Phaser Editor documents an MCP Server with over 40 specialised tools. MCP-compatible agents such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and Copilot can use it to manipulate scenes programmatically, for example creating emitters, reorganising layers and renaming objects. That is a real first-party automation surface, but the evidence never shows a way to write your own custom tools, editor scripts or plugins. Missing for 10: a documented editor plugin/extension API, user-authored editor scripts or custom tools, programmatic asset-pipeline manipulation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can extend and automate the editor itself — custom tools, editor scripts, plugins that manipulate scenes and assets programmatically

citations.quote: For power users, the MCP Server goes deeper. It implements over 40 specialised tools and integrates directly with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP-compatible tools.
Create a particle emitter, reorganise a scene into layers, rename a bunch of objects — it handles it without switching tools.
